reason: The deployed policy's real decision rule is 'max_amount > Rs 7,964 AND time_to_escalation > 7 days'. src/coevolution.py's own attacker search sampled time_to_escalation only from 10-30 days, never below 10 - so the zero-evasions-found, fully-converged certificate never actually tested a fast-strike ring. This monitor simulates rings gradually adapting toward a faster strike time and shows recall collapsing once real-world behavior moves outside the envelope that was actually tested.
